title: Agente09_UxUiDesigner Handoff Package
description: Schema for the Design Package Handoff produced by Agente09_UxUiDesigner and delivered to Agente05_DevFrontend via Agente00_TechLead.

artifact_produced.description: The primary artifact produced. Always 'Design_Package' for this agent.

summary.description: High-level description of the design work — which feature, how many screens, which skills were applied.

screens_designed.description: List of all screens included in this design package.

states_designed.description: Which screen states were designed for this screen.

has_mobile_wireframe.description: True if a mobile (< sm:) wireframe was produced for this screen.

has_desktop_wireframe.description: True if a desktop (lg:+) wireframe was produced for this screen.

wireframe_ref.description: Reference to the wireframe in Wireframes.md.

spec_ref.description: Reference to the component spec in UI_Spec.md.

prd_requirements.description: PRD acceptance criteria this screen addresses.

prd_coverage.description: Traceability map: PRD acceptance criterion → design artifact.

prd_section.description: PRD section or acceptance criterion identifier.

design_artifact.description: The design artifact that covers this PRD requirement.

status.description: Coverage status. 'escalated' means the requirement is ambiguous and has been flagged to Tech Lead.

notes.description: Notes on partial coverage or escalation reason.

assumptions.description: Design assumptions made where PRD or Architecture did not provide complete guidance.

impact.description: What breaks or changes in the design if this assumption is wrong.

open_questions.description: Unresolved questions that may affect frontend implementation.

blocking.description: If true, this blocks READY_FOR_FRONTEND — must be resolved before submission.

directed_to.description: Which agent or role should resolve this question.

escalations.description: Items escalated to Tech Lead during this design cycle.

resolution.description: How the escalation was resolved (if status is resolved or incorporated).

required_next_agent.description: Always Agente05_DevFrontend — the Design Package is consumed by the Frontend Developer.

validation_checklist.description: Self-review items — each must be confirmed before gate_ready: true.
examples: All 4 states designed for every async component
Mobile and desktop wireframes present for all primary screens
All design elements use generic tokens (no hardcoded hex values)
All interactive elements have ARIA labels specified
All form fields have labels, placeholders, validation messages
All images have alt text and dimensions specified (for next/image)
All copy text is exact (no placeholders like '[text here]')
All UX flow error paths documented
All PRD acceptance criteria traced to design artifacts
Usability review completed — no critical friction points unresolved
Design System Application checklist completed — no hardcoded values
Accessibility basics checklist completed — WCAG AA requirements addressed

implementation_notes.description: Summary of implementation-relevant design decisions for Agente05_DevFrontend.

screens_count.description: Total number of screens in this design package.

async_components_count.description: Number of components that fetch async data (each requires all 4 states).

new_components_proposed.description: New UI components proposed (each must be justified — existing components should be used when possible).

justification.description: Why no existing component covers this need.

design_token_gaps.description: Design tokens needed but not in the generic set. Each must be escalated to Tech Lead.

usage.description: Where and how this token would be used.

escalation_status.description: Status of the escalation for this token.

gate_ready.description: True only when all validation checklist items are confirmed, no blocking open questions remain, and all escalations are resolved.
